lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Witness BoxNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 41A DEAD MAN IN THE WITNESS BOX: MR SHERLOCK HOLMESThe Old Bailey is full at ten in the morning, and fuller by eleven, when the clerk calls the name. There is a pause. A tall, thin man in a black coat comes through the door at the back of the court, and the room rises, without orders, like a congregation. The Colonel looks up, and at last he is not smiling. The evidence takes three hours. The verdict takes twenty minutes. You are not allowed to go home by the front door, which is held by the press, and you are taken out through the cellars. It is the end of your quiet, and a good beginning of the rest. He is remembered as the world prefers to remember him: sharp, odd, brilliant and a little aloof.
